note: The complete list of harness workarounds: lines in the test harnesses that change the sim's defs or AI info to dodge a sim defect. VF 3.6.2: G6 does NOT apply them (the shipped game does not); the feasibility harness (tests/campaign/_lib.mjs) does, as it always did. tests/golden/harness_workarounds.test.mjs fails when a workaround line appears that is not in this list (or one listed disappears), so none can be added silently. Adding or removing a row needs two golden_log.md entries (author excluded).

workarounds.reason: SIM defect docs/requests/campaign_sim_bugs.md #1: a siege-role unit without a ranged weapon (the Trojan horse) crashed breachBehaviour; the harness switches the siege AI flag off so the missions can be measured.
appliedBy: tests/campaign/_lib.mjs (every feasibility battle, legacy and RP0 records)
workarounds.measured: baseline 4aafd2e, regime default_meta and baked, seed 1, deployment of the counter bot: mission 7 (troy_giftshop, player horse) identical with and without (win, t 104.00, 3 stars in default_meta); mission 9 (zeus_bad_day, enemy horse in wave 3) differs: with 85.57 s / 3 stars, without 91.10 s / 2 stars (default_meta). Neither run crashed. G6 therefore records the unworked-around battle.
